name: prestart
description: PreStart Lite: daily vehicle pre-start checks and a defect workflow for small fleets, on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.dev: npm run build:css && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build:css && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test

AUTH_SECRET.description: Signs sign-in sessions. Paste a long random string of **at least 32 characters** (for example the output of `openssl rand -hex 32`). Do not reuse the example value: the app refuses to start with it.

DB.description: Stores vehicles, checklists, checks, defects and accounts.

PHOTOS.description: Private storage for check and defect photos. Never public.
